Select a workflow from the list on the left, or create one with "+ Add".

In the node view, right-click the canvas to add a task or
dependency template at that position. Drag from a task's right circle (output)
to another task's left circle (input) to create a dependency
(task that must finish first → successor). Circular dependencies are rejected automatically.

Double-click a dependency line to set its type (finish→start / start→start)
and lag (working days in between). The default is "finish→start, lag 0";
only lines with other settings get a label such as "SS+2".

Switch to "Table view" at the top right of the tab to edit the same content
as a table that is easier to scan.
